statements.applied_to: Y123, faulted Y124, and perfect Y124 structures
statements.quote: In order to assess the amount of V Cu along a single column of the double Cu—O chain of an intergrowth, images of Y123, faulted Y124, and perfect Y124 structures have been simulated using the STEM_CELL software (see Figure 2 ; details of the simulations are given in the Section S1, Supporting Information).

We have used density functional theory (DFT) calculations to identify the stability of different vacancy configurations by comparing their formation energies., We have used two different supercells, one with an overall stoichiometry of Y2Ba4Cu7O14 (Y247), where single and double Cu—O chains alternate, and the other with an overall stoichiometry of YBa2Cu4O8 with only Cu—O double chains.

statements.attributed: reported ferromagnetic coupling in dilute-magnetic semiconductors
statements.applied_to: Y123 matrix with O-decorated Cu vacancies
statements.quote: This ferromagnetic coupling between the localized moments associated with the O‐decorated Cu vacancies is reminiscent of dilute‐magnetic semiconductors., However, given the restriction on the size of the supercells that can be used in DFT, it is not possible to comment on long‐range magnetic ordering, especially in a scenario where the 2V Cu+3V O defect clusters are scattered within the Y123 matrix as observed experimentally, and thus not present as an extended network of neighboring vacancy clusters.

statements.attributed: reported a Cu-XMCD signal in sputtered Y123 thin film
statements.applied_to: Y123 film with Y124 defect density
statements.quote: The percentage of Cu‐XMCD signal measured in our samples is nonlinear with the magnetic field and about a factor of three larger than that reported for sputtered Y123 thin film, and provides an experimental indication that our proposed defect‐mediated mechanism is active and large in samples with a large Y124 defect density while they lead to a different phenomenology, i.e., diluted ferromagnetism.

statements.attributed: reported a huge enhancement of vortex pinning efficiency in nanocomposite cuprate films
statements.quote: Owing to the fact that the density of the Y124 intergrowths is strongly increased in nanocomposite cuprate films, in parallel to a huge enhancement of vortex pinning efficiency, one may wonder if the novel ferromagnetic behavior could play a role in pinning vortices.

statements.attributed: developed the principal component analysis (PCA) method for EELS
statements.quote: The principal component analysis (PCA) method was used to eliminate noise in atomic‐resolution EELS elemental maps. EELS elemental maps were generated by integrating the PCA‐treated spectra over a 40 eV window, after background subtraction.
